generations.rawResponse:
ASSIST
Since edge weights are 0 or 1, replace the FIFO queue with a deque and use 0–1 BFS. Keep a distance array initialized to infinity; whenever `dist[u] + w` improves `dist[v]`, update it and its parent, then push `v` to the front for weight 0 or the back for weight 1. Don’t mark vertices permanently visited on enqueue, since a later route can improve their distance. The running time is O(V + E), with O(V) auxiliary space; for 10,000 vertices and 50,000 edges, this is O(60,000).
